description: Agency guest-post link campaign: 5 posts/month across 4 target URLs. Slots chosen by product-market fit (searcher intent must match what Shelf actually does), keywords by GSC striking-distance data. Query-level baselines captured pre-campaign so we can tell whether links moved rankings or just produced invoices.

baseline.note: Trailing 90 days of GSC data, captured before first guest post shipped.

anchorRules.note: Max 1-2 exact-match anchors per month ACROSS all 5 posts. Rest branded (Shelf, Shelf asset management), naked URL, or partial/natural phrasing. Host sites must be topically relevant: ops, IT, education, AV/media, facilities. Vendor reports live post URLs monthly for indexation QA.

slots.rationale: Bookings IS the Team plan — searchers here are multi-user orgs (SSO expansion path). Striking distance on all three targets. Weighted 2x: biggest gap between position and revenue.

Page owns the free/QR asset-tracking cluster and converts demos. NOTE: bare head term 'asset tracking software' (4,167 impr) ranks via the HOMEPAGE (pos 21.3) — this page is pos 53 for it. Do NOT anchor the bare head term here; anchor the cluster this page owns.

The open-source/free claim is the one only Shelf can make in this category. 64% of demo submissions land on /. Both head modifiers sit top-of-page-2 where links move the needle most. Bare heads ('asset tracking software' pos 21.3 / 4,167 impr, 'asset management software' ~8k impr/mo) also resolve here and ride along on domain authority.

The 'asset tag generator' searcher has assets in hand and is about to label them — step one of the Shelf workflow. Feeds signup + label store. Replaced MACRS calculator slot: accountants doing tax prep never become asset-tracking customers.

controls.note: Untouched page, same page type. If controls rise with targets, credit the tide, not the vendor.
The slot we removed from the package. Doubles as counterfactual: does it hold rank without links?

gates.criteria: ≥80% of placed posts live, indexed by Google (site: check), on topically relevant hosts, dofollow. FAILURE = vendor inventory is junk; renegotiate or exit before rankings data even matters.

Target-query impressions +30% vs baseline on the two striking-distance slots (equipment-reservations, asset-tracking), net of control drift. Impressions move before positions stabilize — earliest honest ranking signal.
≥3-position improvement on at least half of tracked queries, net of control drift. FAILURE = re-weight slots, change anchors, or change vendor.

Clicks 2x on reservations + asset-tracking slots; homepage OSS cluster top-5; label designer pos ≤1.5 on 'asset tag generator'. Manual: PostHog signup_click + demo_form_submit attributed to target landing pages vs prior 90d. Compute cost per incremental click/demo vs package price.
